# U122: The owner’s week on Home: on Monday nothing is asked and there is no primary button; the day before the deadline the check-in is the one primary; a completed week is one sentence with the next date; a passed deadline is never said to someone who met it; each count opens exactly its goals

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `HOME-OWNER`
- **Budget:** at most 6 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Tunde, at `/` in the demo on Monday 9 November 2026.
- **Set-up it takes for granted:**
  - The demo on each day is the demo as it stands that day. On Monday 9 November Tunde Bakare (`tunde`) owns two goals, `lead-rollback` and `cfr-contract`, with week 46’s check-ins still to do, due Thursday 12 November. By Wednesday 11 November both are posted, on time, that morning (Faro’s demo has them; a rebuild working from [`workspace.json`](../../conformance/workspace.json), built for 5 November, posts them itself before the Wednesday step). Friday 13 November adds nothing.
  - On Wednesday 11 November Rhea Kapoor (`rhea`) still has week 46 check-ins to do, so Check-ins leads her Home ([Home](../../core/rules/home.md), lead 2).
  - “Switch to Rhea in the Demo panel” changes who is viewing in the same browser; a fresh browser as Rhea does the same for a rebuild.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U122

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Tunde (`tunde`).
- _Note:_ Monday 9 Nov: Tunde's two check-ins are due Thursday. Nothing is asked of him yet: one sentence, no primary button.
- Go to `/` in the demo on Monday 9 November 2026.
- **Check:** Home’s lead shows.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `/Nothing is asked of you today\./.test(monday) && /due by Thursday 12 Nov\. You have 2 to do\./.test(monday)`, where `const hero = p.locator('.home-hero').first()`; `const monday = await hero.innerText()`. Else it says: Monday’s Home said “{monday.replace(/\s+/g, ' ')}”.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the main button in Home (`.page.home .btn.primary`) is not there (else: Monday’s Home has a primary button with nothing asked).
- _Note:_ Your goals are counted once, and each count opens exactly those goals.
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `heads.filter((t) => /^Your goals/.test(t.trim())).length === 1 && /Your goals\s*·?\s*2\b/.test(heads.join(' '))`, where `const heads = await p.locator('.page.home h2').allInnerTexts()`. Else it says: Home’s headings: {heads.join(' | ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ')}.
- For each of `counts`:
  - **Step.** Press the link in the status counts (each a shape, a number and a word, linking to those goals) in the “Your goals” block on Home (`.home-mine .home-counts a`).
  - **Check:** The address becomes “/goals?scope=mine&status=”.
  - **Check:** The Goals count line shows.
  - **Check:** It fails if “{text.trim()}” opened “{line}”.
  - Press the browser’s Back.
  - **Check:** The status counts (each a shape, a number and a word, linking to those goals) in the “Your goals” block on Home (`.home-mine .home-counts`) shows.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “monday”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Wednesday 11 Nov: both are in (the example posts them). One sentence with the next date, and no button.
- Go to `/` in the demo on Wednesday 11 November 2026.
- **Check:** Home’s lead shows.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `/Both (of your )?check-ins are in (for week 46|before Thursday’s review|by Thursday)/.test(done) && /The next are due by Thursday 19 Nov\./.test(done) && await p.locator('.page.home .btn.primary').count() === 0`, where `const hero = p.locator('.home-hero').first()`; `const done = await hero.innerText()`. Else it says: Wednesday’s Home said “{done.replace(/\s+/g, ' ')}”.
- _Note:_ Friday 13 Nov: the deadline he met is not said.
- Go to `/` in the demo on Friday 13 November 2026.
- **Check:** Home’s lead shows.
- **Check:** It fails if Friday’s Home tells Tunde, who met it, about Thursday’s deadline: “{worked out in the journey as `(friday.match(/[^\n]*(were due|Thursday 12 Nov|late)[^\n]*/) || [''])[0]`}”.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “friday”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ The day before the deadline, a check-in still to do is the one primary (Rhea, five to do on Wednesday 11 Nov).
- Switch to Rhea in the Demo panel (the quiet Demo button): a role card’s person, or anyone else by typing their name.
- Go to `/` in the demo on Wednesday 11 November 2026.
- **Check:** Home’s lead shows.
- **Check:** (`errors`) met when `/Check-ins are due by Thursday 12 Nov, tomorrow/.test(lead) && /\d+ check-ins? to do/.test(lead) && await p.locator('.page.home .btn.primary').count() === 1 && await start.count() === 1`, where `const hero = p.locator('.home-hero').first()`; `const lead = await hero.innerText()`; `const start = hero.getByRole('link', { name: /Start check-in|Pick up where you left off/ })`. Else it says: Rhea’s Wednesday lead: “{lead.replace(/\s+/g, ' ')}”.
- **Step.** Press the “Start check-in / Pick up where you left off” link in Home’s lead.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/check-in”.
- **Check:** (`logged`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
